source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Cyclops (Scott Summers) (archived 29 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Born a mutant; his eyes channel concussive force from another dimension, and a childhood head injury left him unable to shut it off.

abilities.name: Optic blasts
abilities.detail: Fires an unheated, ruby-coloured beam of concussive force from his eyes, held back only by his eyelids or ruby quartz lenses.

abilities.name: Beam control
abilities.detail: Tunes width and force from a pencil-thin jet to a 90-foot sweep; at full power it can puncture an inch of carbon steel at close range.

abilities.name: Spatial awareness
abilities.detail: An instinct for angles lets him bank his blasts off a dozen or more surfaces and still hit his target.

abilities.name: Energy immunity
abilities.detail: His own beams cannot hurt him, and he and his brother Havok are immune to each other's powers.

abilities.name: Tactician and leader
abilities.detail: Long-time leader of the X-Men who reads a fight as it unfolds; on Krakoa he wrote defence plans for every scenario he could imagine.

abilities.name: Martial artist
abilities.detail: Holds black belts in judo and aikido, can beat six ordinary men with his eyes shut, and has held his own against Wolverine.

abilities.name: Expert pilot
abilities.detail: Flies fixed-wing aircraft at an expert level, a skill he shares with his father.

abilities.name: Telepathic resistance
abilities.detail: Years close to telepaths taught him to resist intrusion and keep secrets from powerful mind readers.

feats.text: On the X-Men's first mission he blasted a hole in Magneto's magnetic force field, helping drive Magneto out of the captured Cape Citadel base.
Forced to fire at full power while under another mutant's control, he overloaded the energy-absorbing Bishop in seconds; Iron Man measured over two gigawatts.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Civil War: X-Men Vol 1 4

feats.text: Hit the Hulk with his optic blast at full force, peeling away some of his skin before the Hulk waded through and grabbed him.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: World War Hulk: X-Men Vol 1 2

feats.text: With Jean steadying him, he blasted Sabretooth out of the Statue of Liberty.
Found a clean shot that wounded Magneto, freeing Wolverine to wreck the mutation machine atop the statue.
